summary: Frontend-only retest of the scripture banner blink fix. The described fix is NOT in the code. /app/frontend/src/components/ScriptureBanner.jsx still uses framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' with a single keyed motion.p (no stacked grid [grid-area:1/1], no CSS opacity crossfade). AdminVerses.jsx placeholders are unchanged ('Verse text', 'Reference (e.g. 1 Timothy 4:7)', 'NIV') and say nothing about book quotes. Measurements: every 250ms for 30s, through 4 rotations, at 1920px and 390px. Banner height stayed constant (102px desktop, 142px mobile) thanks to min-height. Banner top and step-01 y positions also stayed constant, so there was no layout shift. However, only 1 verse element ever exists, and per-frame sampling over 15s showed the banner's highest verse opacity falling to 0 (33 frames below 0.2) at each change. The old verse fades out fully before the new one fades in, so the banner goes blank for a moment. This is the blink the user reported. Passed: borders (header bottom 5px gold, banner top 5px gold, banner bottom 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.4)); the footer copyright on the welcome and dashboard pages; the admin quote entry (saved 'TEST quote from the book' / 'The Lord's Gym, Ch. 3' with blank translation, got the toast, the welcome banner showed the reference with no translation label).

rca of the issue: Root cause: the banner uses framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait', which unmounts the old verse (exit fade to 0) before mounting the new one (enter from 0). This leaves a blank moment on every rotation. Reproduction: open /, sample opacity per frame for 15s, and the highest opacity reaches 0 at each change. Mitigation: render all verses stacked in one grid cell and crossfade with CSS opacity transitions so one verse is always partly visible.
